articles.title: Vehicle Vandalised After Accident During Kanwar Yatra in Muzaffarnagar; Police Launch Probe
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A vehicle was vandalised by a group of Kanwariyas after it allegedly hit a pilgrim in Uttar Pradesh's Muzaffarnagar, triggering chaos near a busy intersection. According to reports, the occupants of the vehicle fled the spot fearing for their safety after the accident.

body.html:
A vehicle was vandalised by a group of Kanwariyas after it allegedly hit a pilgrim in Uttar Pradesh's Muzaffarnagar, triggering chaos near a busy intersection.

According to reports, the occupants of the vehicle fled the spot fearing for their safety after the accident. Soon after, a large crowd gathered, and some people allegedly damaged the car using stones and sticks, causing panic among nearby shopkeepers and passersby.

The incident temporarily disrupted traffic on the national highway, leading to a major traffic jam on both sides of the road.

Videos of the vandalism, recorded by eyewitnesses, have gone viral on social media, showing the damaged vehicle amid the commotion.

Purkaji Police reached the spot with additional personnel, brought the situation under control, dispersed the crowd, removed the damaged vehicle, and restored traffic movement.

Police said no one is permitted to take the law into their own hands. Officials are identifying those involved using the viral videos and said legal action will be taken based on the investigation and complaints received.

#Muzaffarnagar #KanwarYatra #UttarPradesh

articles.title: Mobile Shop Owner Attacked With Sickle in Pune; Police Suspect Fugitive Gangster’s Role
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A 24-year-old mobile phone shop owner was allegedly attacked with a sickle by a group of 8–10 men in broad daylight in Pune's Kothrud area, with police suspecting the involvement of associates of fugitive gangster Nilesh Ghaywal.

body.html:
A 24-year-old mobile phone shop owner was allegedly attacked with a sickle by a group of 8–10 men in broad daylight in Pune's Kothrud area, with police suspecting the involvement of associates of fugitive gangster Nilesh Ghaywal.

According to police, the victim, identified as Amit Shinde, was standing outside his shop at around 7 pm on Tuesday when the assailants arrived on two-wheelers and repeatedly attacked him with a sickle before fleeing the scene.

Investigators believe the assault may have been carried out in retaliation for a complaint Shinde had filed against Nilesh Ghaywal and his gang a few months ago.

The entire incident was captured on nearby CCTV cameras, and police have seized the footage as part of the investigation. A manhunt has been launched to identify and arrest the attackers.

Police said Ghaywal, who is wanted in multiple criminal cases, is believed to be operating from outside the country, while his brother was arrested by Pune Police from Rajasthan earlier this year.

The brazen attack has raised fresh concerns over gang-related violence in Pune and the safety of those who cooperate with law enforcement. Further investigation is underway.

#Pune #Maharashtra #CrimeNews #GangWar #CCTV

articles.title: Railway Employee Risks Life to Save Elderly Warkari From Oncoming Train in Pune, Heroic Rescue
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A railway employee displayed remarkable courage by risking his own life to save an elderly Warkari devotee who fell onto the tracks moments before an approaching train in Pune.

body.html:
A railway employee displayed remarkable courage by risking his own life to save an elderly Warkari devotee who fell onto the tracks moments before an approaching train in Pune.

The incident occurred when the senior citizen, who was travelling from Pune to Pandharpur for the Ashadhi Wari pilgrimage, accidentally slipped and fell onto the railway tracks as a train approached.

Acting without hesitation, the railway employee rushed onto the tracks, pulled the elderly man to safety, and narrowly avoided the oncoming train. The dramatic rescue was captured on CCTV, showing the employee's swift response and presence of mind.

The video has drawn widespread praise on social media, with many lauding the railway staff member for his bravery and selfless act. The incident also serves as a reminder for passengers to exercise caution near railway tracks and platforms.

#Pune #Railways #HeroicRescue #Warkari #AshadhiWari

articles.title: Bengaluru PSI Arrested After Wife Accuses Him of Dowry Harassment, Assault and Domestic Violence
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A Police Sub-Inspector (PSI) posted at the Bengaluru Police Commissioner’s Office has been arrested after his wife, an advocate, accused him of dowry harassment, domestic violence, assault, criminal intimidation, and using his influence to prevent police from registering her complaint.

body.html:
A Police Sub-Inspector (PSI) posted at the Bengaluru Police Commissioner’s Office has been arrested after his wife, an advocate, accused him of dowry harassment, domestic violence, assault, criminal intimidation, and using his influence to prevent police from registering her complaint.

According to the complainant, she approached Kengeri Police Station, but her complaint was allegedly recorded only as a Non-Cognizable Report (NCR) instead of an FIR. She later submitted a complaint to the Director General of Police (DGP), seeking an impartial investigation.

The woman said she and PSI Bairappa have been married for five years and have a three-year-old daughter. She alleged that after the first three years of marriage, her husband began demanding ₹50 lakh from her family, reportedly following his suspension in a Lokayukta trap case.

She further alleged that he repeatedly assaulted and harassed her over dowry, forced her and their daughter out of the house, questioned her character, and even denied being the child's father.

The complainant also accused the PSI of maintaining inappropriate relationships with multiple women through Instagram, claiming some of them later contacted her and shared screenshots of their conversations.

In another serious allegation, she claimed the officer threatened to have her killed by rowdies and intimidated her by bringing known criminals near her residence. She further alleged that during a domestic dispute on July 12, the PSI attacked her father with a machete when he tried to intervene.

The woman also alleged that Kengeri Police refused to register an FIR because two of the accused officer's batchmates were posted at the police station and were shielding him.

Confirming the action, Deputy Commissioner of Police (Southwest) Anitha B. Haddannavar said that an FIR was registered based on the complaint, the accused PSI has been arrested by Kengeri Police, and further investigation is underway.

#Bengaluru #Karnataka #DomesticViolence #DowryHarassment

articles.title: 4 Girls Trapped in Lift for 30 Minutes in Greater Noida Society, Recite Hanuman Chalisa as Video
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Four girls were trapped inside a lift for nearly 30 minutes at Galaxy Society in Greater Noida West on Monday night after the elevator reportedly malfunctioned. According to residents, the lift suddenly stopped functioning and briefly plunged into darkness.

body.html:
Four girls were trapped inside a lift for nearly 30 minutes at Galaxy Society in Greater Noida West on Monday night after the elevator reportedly malfunctioned.

According to residents, the lift suddenly stopped functioning and briefly plunged into darkness. Although the lights returned after a short while, the girls remained stuck inside and were visibly frightened.

A video shared by society residents, which has since gone viral on social media, shows the girls calmly reciting the Hanuman Chalisa while waiting to be rescued.

Residents alleged that the elevators in the society are in poor condition and claimed that similar breakdowns have occurred on multiple occasions. They said the girls were eventually rescued after around half an hour.

The incident has once again raised concerns over lift maintenance and safety standards in high-rise residential societies.

#GreaterNoida #LiftMalfunction #GalaxySociety #ViralVideo

articles.title: Agra: Husband Catches Wife With Alleged Lover, Heated Confrontation
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A dramatic confrontation unfolded at a hotel in Agra's New Agra area after a husband allegedly caught his wife with her suspected boyfriend, triggering a heated argument that was captured on video and widely circulated on social media.

body.html:
A dramatic confrontation unfolded at a hotel in Agra's New Agra area after a husband allegedly caught his wife with her suspected boyfriend, triggering a heated argument that was captured on video and widely circulated on social media.

According to police, the incident occurred on Monday afternoon. The husband, a silver trader from Kamla Nagar, allegedly suspected his wife of having an extramarital relationship and had been monitoring her movements for several months.

He claimed his wife left home around 3 pm, saying she was going out for work, but instead went to a hotel in the Dayalbagh area where her alleged lover was waiting. The husband reportedly followed her to the hotel and confronted the pair, leading to a heated argument and scuffle.

Hotel staff intervened and informed the police as a crowd gathered at the scene. All three were taken to the New Agra Police Station for questioning.

During the inquiry, police found that the wife had previously filed a domestic violence case against her husband, although the couple had continued living together. Frequent disputes between the two were also reported.

After nearly three hours of discussions involving family members, the husband and wife agreed to a compromise. According to New Agra Station House Officer Nishamak Tyagi, neither side filed a formal complaint, and no case was registered.

Videos of the confrontation have gone viral on social media. In one clip, the husband alleges that his wife had filed a domestic violence case to conceal her alleged relationship. These allegations have not been independently verified.

#Agra #UttarPradesh #HotelDrama #ViralVideo #Relationship

articles.title: Shocking! Hyderabad Cop Lets 6-Year-Old Drive on Busy Road | Viral Video
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking display of negligence by a law enforcement officer has sparked outrage in Hyderabad! A Police Sub-Inspector has been booked after a viral video showed him allowing his six-and-a-half-year-old granddaughter to drive a Maruti Swift on a busy public road.

body.html:
A shocking display of negligence by a law enforcement officer has sparked outrage in Hyderabad! A Police Sub-Inspector has been booked after a viral video showed him allowing his six-and-a-half-year-old granddaughter to drive a Maruti Swift on a busy public road.

The incident, which took place on July 11, shows the young girl at the wheel while the officer, identified as Pujari Thirupathi, sat in the passenger seat with one hand on the steering wheel. Traffic was held up until alert local residents intervened, stopped the vehicle, and confronted the officer for endangering public safety.

Hyderabad Police have now registered a case against the SI under Section 125 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) for negligent conduct, as well as under the Motor Vehicles Act. Watch the full video to see the confrontation and learn the details of the investigation.
